segments.text:
V. 10.
All things that are mine are thine, and that are thine are mine— Theſe are very high and ſtrong Expreſſions, too grand for any mere Creature to uſe; as implying that all Things whatſoever, incluſive of the Divine Nature, Perfections, and Operations, are the comman Property of the Father and the Son. And this is the Original Ground of that peculiar Property, which both the Father and the Son have in the Perſons, who were given to Chriſt as Mediator; according to what is ſaid in the Cloſe of the Verſe, of his being glorified by them; namely, believing in Him, and ſo acknowledging his Glory.
